<p><span data-math="OABCDEFG"></span> is a cube with side length 1 unit. Take <span data-math="O"></span> as the origin.</p><div class="a-cols a-cube-layout"><div><img class="a-cube" src="../media/example-6-3.svg" alt="Original booklet cube OABCDEFG. O is the origin; OA, OC and OD lie along positive x, y and z respectively, each of length one."></div><div><p>a) Write the vectors <span data-math="\overrightarrow{CB}"></span>, <span data-math="\overrightarrow{AB}"></span> and <span data-math="\overrightarrow{CG}"></span>.</p><p>b) Find the position vectors of <span data-math="F"></span> and <span data-math="G"></span>.</p><p>c) Find vectors <span data-math="\overrightarrow{OF}"></span> and <span data-math="\overrightarrow{AG}"></span>.</p><div data-module="reveal-panel" class="a-reveal"><button class="toggle-panel" aria-pressed="false">Show solution</button><div class="panel-answer" hidden><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="\text{a) }\overrightarrow{CB}=\underset{\sim}{i},\quad\overrightarrow{AB}=\underset{\sim}{j},\quad\overrightarrow{CG}=\underset{\sim}{k}"></span></div><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="\text{b) }\overrightarrow{OF}=\underset{\sim}{i}+\underset{\sim}{j}+\underset{\sim}{k},\quad\overrightarrow{OG}=\underset{\sim}{j}+\underset{\sim}{k}"></span></div><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="\text{c) }\overrightarrow{OF}=\underset{\sim}{i}+\underset{\sim}{j}+\underset{\sim}{k}"></span></div><div class="a-eq"><span data-math="\overrightarrow{AG}=\overrightarrow{OG}-\overrightarrow{OA}=-\underset{\sim}{i}+\underset{\sim}{j}+\underset{\sim}{k}"></span></div></div></div></div></div>
